title: Quadrilaterals and the Midpoint Theorem
summary: Properties of parallelograms, the midpoint theorem and its converse, and Varignon's parallelogram.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Manjari (2026) Part 2: Quadrilaterals (parallelograms, midpoint theorem)

objectives: I can prove and use properties of parallelograms.
I can state and apply the midpoint theorem.
I can explain why the midpoints of any quadrilateral form a parallelogram.
misconceptions: A rhombus is not a parallelogram.
The midpoint line is parallel to any side.
